sale.title: Prices per square meter of old dwellings in housing companies and numbers of transactions by postal code area, quarterly

rent.title: Average rents per square meter for non-subsidised rental dwellings by postal code area by Quarter, Postal code, Number of rooms and Information
notes: The data are suppressed if there are less than 20 observations, or if the share of rental housing companies is high in the postal code.

metadata.methodology: Two-room flats benchmark. Sale: old dwellings in blocks of flats, unadjusted mean transaction price. Rent: non-subsidised two-room dwellings, monthly rent per m². No all-room total is published in these postal tables; room categories are not averaged together. Each metric uses its own official postal boundary vintage. Null means suppressed or unavailable, never zero. QoQ compares adjacent published quarters; changes in the mix of dwellings can affect these averages. This is not a quality-adjusted price index or an individual property valuation.
